scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I recently submitted an application to refinance my home with an FHA loan for $165,000 over 360 months. Can you tell me the status or outcome of my application? Was it approved, denied, or is it still pending?
dialogue.agent: Your FHA refinancing loan application for $165,000 over 360 months was approved and the loan was originated. After origination, your loan was purchased by Ginnie Mae. If you have further questions about the details or terms, please let me know.

dialogue.user: Thank you for letting me know my application was approved and the loan was originated. Can you tell me what my interest rate is and what my total loan costs will be?
dialogue.agent: Your loan has an interest rate of 5.990%. The total loan costs, including fees and charges associated with the loan, are $7,221.78. If you’d like details on any specific costs or other aspects of your loan, let me know.

dialogue.user: Thank you for the information. Since my loan was approved, can you tell me if it is considered a high-cost (HOEPA) loan or if there are any negative amortization features attached to it? Also, what does my debt-to-income ratio mean for my application?
dialogue.agent:
Your loan is not classified as a high-cost (HOEPA) mortgage, and it does not have any negative amortization features. 

Regarding your debt-to-income (DTI) ratio, this figure typically reflects the percentage of your monthly income that goes toward debt payments. In your loan record, specific DTI information is not present, so I am unable to provide that detail.

dialogue.user: Thanks for explaining. One last question: what type of loan product was I approved for other than FHA? Is there a product name or specific type listed? And to confirm, has my loan been transferred anywhere else besides Ginnie Mae, or is Ginnie Mae the only purchaser?
dialogue.agent: You were approved for an FHA: First Lien loan product. According to your loan record, after origination, your loan was purchased by Ginnie Mae, and Ginnie Mae is the only listed purchaser.

dialogue.user:
Thank you for answering all my questions clearly and promptly. I appreciate the straightforward explanations about my loan approval, the terms, and that you let me know when certain details weren’t available. I’m glad there are no high-cost or negative amortization features, and Ginnie Mae is the purchaser. I feel well informed about the process.

<Satisfied> – The interaction was professional and informative. I got the answers I needed about my loan, though some specific DTI info wasn’t available. Overall, I’m satisfied with the experience.
